Question: assalamualaikum,at the time of voting the ink is put on nail bed,is gusl valid after the ink is put,as it stays very long. Answer ID: 28211 Posted on: Aug 31, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 51/41/H=1432) Ghusl and wudhu is valid. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
